name: Macimorelin
description: An orally active ghrelin receptor agonist approved as a single-dose diagnostic test for adult growth hormone deficiency. It is a diagnostic agent, not a therapy.

systems.note: Provokes somatotroph GH release as a diagnostic challenge; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.

monitors.why: Read alongside the provocative test result when characterising the GH axis.
